include_once comm_PerDefinition.txt

platform_type REAR_COMM_PLATFORM WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature COMMAND_VEHICLE_SIG
  mover WSF_GROUND_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
  end_mover
  comm sat_link_a WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
      channels 4
      mode "default"
        transfer_rate 16 mbits/sec
      end_mode
    end_medium
    transmitter
      frequency 14.2 GHz
      bandwidth 54 MHz
      power 20 W
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_GROUND_MOBILE_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter
    receiver
      frequency 11.8 GHz
      bandwidth 54 MHz
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_GROUND_MOBILE_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB
      detection_threshold -1000 dB
    end_receiver
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm
  comm sat_link_b WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
      channels 4
      mode "default"
        transfer_rate 16 mbits/sec
      end_mode
    end_medium
    transmitter
      frequency 14.2 GHz
      bandwidth 54 MHz
      power 20 W
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_GROUND_MOBILE_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter
    receiver
      frequency 11.8 GHz
      bandwidth 54 MHz
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern SAT_GROUND_MOBILE_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB
      detection_threshold -1000 dB
    end_receiver
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm
  comm microwave_link WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
      channels 4
      mode "default"
        transfer_rate 80 mbits/sec
      end_mode
    end_medium
    transmitter
      frequency 8.2 GHz
      bandwidth 50 MHz
      power 20 W
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern MICRO_REAR_PLATFORM_DIR_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
      check_terrain_masking off
    end_transmitter
    receiver
      frequency 8.2 GHz
      bandwidth 50 MHz
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern MICRO_REAR_PLATFORM_DIR_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB
      check_terrain_masking off
      detection_threshold -1000 dB
    end_receiver
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm
  comm fiber_link WSF_COMM_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name FIBER_NET
    transfer_rate 1000 mbits/sec
    channels 4
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm
  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR

    script_variables
      Array<string> fw_sit_next = { "command_vehicle", "command_vehicle" };//前向链路下一跳
      Array<string> fw_sit_out  = { "fiber_link", "fiber_link" };
      Array<string> fw_sit_in   = { "fiber_link", "fiber_link" };
      Array<string> fw_sit_dst  = { "mission_uav_02", "mission_uav_03" };//目的平台
      Array<string> fw_sit_size = { "256", "256" };

      Array<string> fw_tgt_next = { "command_vehicle", "command_vehicle" };
      Array<string> fw_tgt_out  = { "fiber_link", "fiber_link" };
      Array<string> fw_tgt_in   = { "fiber_link", "fiber_link" };
      Array<string> fw_tgt_dst  = { "mission_uav_02", "mission_uav_03" };
      Array<string> fw_tgt_size = { "512", "128" };
    end_script_variables

    execute at_interval_of 5 sec
      foreach (int i : string dst in fw_sit_dst) {
        string nxts = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dst + "_next_platform_name");
        if (nxts != "")
        {
          Array<string> nexts = nxts.Split("|");
          Array<string> outs  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dst + "_out_port_name").Split("|");
          Array<string> ins   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardSituation_" + dst + "_next_in_port_name").Split("|");

          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " kForwardSituation_" + dst + "_next_platform_name New Path Chenged");

          foreach (int j : string nxt in nexts) {
            WsfMessage msg = WsfMessage();
            msg.SetType("kForwardSituation");
            msg.SetSizeInBits((int)fw_sit_size[i]);
            msg.SetAuxData("origin_sender", PLATFORM.Name());
            msg.SetAuxData("destination", dst);
            PLATFORM.Comm(outs[j]).SendMessage(msg, nxt, ins[j]);

            writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " SendMessage Out Port:[" + outs[j] + "] kForwardSituation DataSize:[" + fw_sit_size[i] + "] Destination:[" + dst + "] Next Plat:[" + nxt + "] Next Port:[" + ins[j] + "]");
          }
        }
        else
        {
          WsfMessage msg = WsfMessage();
          msg.SetType("kForwardSituation");
          msg.SetSizeInBits((int)fw_sit_size[i]);
          msg.SetAuxData("origin_sender", PLATFORM.Name());
          msg.SetAuxData("destination", fw_sit_dst[i]);
          PLATFORM.Comm(fw_sit_out[i]).SendMessage(msg, fw_sit_next[i], fw_sit_in[i]);

          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " SendMessage Out Port:[" + fw_sit_out[i] + "] kForwardSituation DataSize:[" + fw_sit_size[i] + "] Destination:[" + fw_sit_dst[i] + "] Next Plat:[" + fw_sit_next[i] + "] Next Port:[" + fw_sit_in[i] + "]");
        }
      }
      foreach (int i : string dst in fw_tgt_dst) {
        string nxts2 = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dst + "_next_platform_name");
        if (nxts2 != "") {
          Array<string> nexts2 = nxts2.Split("|");
          Array<string> outs2  = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dst + "_out_port_name").Split("|");
          Array<string> ins2   = PLATFORM.AuxDataString("kForwardTarget_" + dst + "_next_in_port_name").Split("|");

          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " kForwardTarget_" + dst + "_next_platform_name New Path Chenged");

          foreach (int j : string nxt in nexts2) {
            WsfMessage msg = WsfMessage();
            msg.SetType("kForwardTarget");
            msg.SetSizeInBits((int)fw_tgt_size[i]);
            msg.SetAuxData("origin_sender", PLATFORM.Name());
            msg.SetAuxData("destination", dst);
            PLATFORM.Comm(outs2[j]).SendMessage(msg, nxt, ins2[j]);

            writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " SendMessage Out Port:[" + outs2[j] + "] kForwardTarget DataSize:[" + fw_tgt_size[i] + "] Destination:[" + dst + "] Next Plat:[" + nxt + "] Next Port:[" + ins2[j] + "]");
          }
        }
        else {
          WsfMessage msg = WsfMessage();
          msg.SetType("kForwardTarget");
          msg.SetSizeInBits((int)fw_tgt_size[i]);
          msg.SetAuxData("origin_sender", PLATFORM.Name());
          msg.SetAuxData("destination", fw_tgt_dst[i]);
          PLATFORM.Comm(fw_tgt_out[i]).SendMessage(msg, fw_tgt_next[i], fw_tgt_in[i]);

          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " SendMessage Out Port:[" + fw_tgt_out[i] + "] kForwardTarget DataSize:[" + fw_tgt_size[i] + "] Destination:[" + fw_tgt_dst[i] + "] Next Plat:[" + fw_tgt_next[i] + "] Next Port:[" + fw_tgt_in[i] + "]");
        }
      }
    end_execute

    on_message
      default
        script
          writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " RECV " + MESSAGE.Type() + " from " + MESSAGE.Originator());
        end_script
    end_on_message

  end_processor

  add processor link_calc WSF_LINK_CALC_PROCESSOR

    update_interval 5 sec

    emergency_threshold 1e-5
    warning_threshold   1e-6
    value_threshold_ber 1e-7
    jamming_range  30
    channel_encoding_scheme 0

    traffic_type            [{"mission_uav_02":{"forward":[{"traffice_type":"kForwardSituation","data_volume_bits":256,"trans_freq":5},{"traffice_type":"kForwardTarget","data_volume_bits":512,"trans_freq":10}],"return":[{"traffice_type":"kReturnReconVideo","data_volume_bits":8192,"trans_freq":3},{"traffice_type":"kReturnReconStatus","data_volume_bits":512,"trans_freq":10}]}},{"mission_uav_03":{"forward":[{"traffice_type":"kForwardSituation","data_volume_bits":256,"trans_freq":5},{"traffice_type":"kForwardTarget","data_volume_bits":128,"trans_freq":10}],"return":[{"traffice_type":"kReturnReconVideo","data_volume_bits":4096,"trans_freq":5},{"traffice_type":"kReturnReconStatus","data_volume_bits":256,"trans_freq":10}]}}]
    relay_uav_names         ["mission_uav_01"]
    hot_link_ret            {"link1":[{"platform":"mission_uav_02","inPort":"","outPort":"c_band_downlink"},{"platform":"command_vehicle","inPort":"c_band_downlink","outPort":"fiber_link"},{"platform":"rear_comm_vehicle","inPort":"fiber_link","outPort":""}],"link2":[{"platform":"mission_uav_03","inPort":"","outPort":"c_band_downlink"},{"platform":"command_vehicle","inPort":"c_band_downlink","outPort":"fiber_link"},{"platform":"rear_comm_vehicle","inPort":"fiber_link","outPort":""}]}
    hot_link_fw             {"link1":[{"platform":"rear_comm_vehicle","inPort":"","outPort":"fiber_link"},{"platform":"command_vehicle","inPort":"fiber_link","outPort":"c_band_uplink"},{"platform":"mission_uav_02","inPort":"c_band_uplink","outPort":""}],"link2":[{"platform":"rear_comm_vehicle","inPort":"","outPort":"fiber_link"},{"platform":"command_vehicle","inPort":"fiber_link","outPort":"c_band_uplink"},{"platform":"mission_uav_03","inPort":"c_band_uplink","outPort":""}]}
    port_params
